# ADR-032 — `google-services.json` is git-ignored; supplied to EAS as a file-type environment variable

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

`apps/mobile/google-services.json` is git-ignored rather than committed. Google treats it as non-secret (it ships inside the APK), but it embeds a Google API key, so it is excluded as defense in depth. Local `expo run:android` reads it from that path via `android.googleServicesFile`; EAS Build must supply it as a file-type EAS environment variable, which additionally requires migrating `app.json` to a dynamic `app.config.ts`
